xs.$description: New token (2026-10-11), added for Drawer's own panel — the width of a side panel (the height cap of a top or bottom one) at `xs`: a narrow list or a few settings. The same value as the matching `dialog.max-width` step, but it names the extent of an edge-attached panel, not a centred window's measure.
